target.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves Skills are copied into the sandbox workspace on every sandbox setup. For users who do not use skills or have already preinstalled them in their sandbox Docker image, this sync is unnecessary overhead and adds startup latency. Related: #97638 ## Why This Change Was Made Adds `skipSkillsSync` as an optional boolean under `agents.defaults.sandbox` and `agents.list[].sandbox`, defaulting to `false`. When enabled: 1. **File copying skipped**: `syncSkillsToWorkspace` is not called — no skill files are copied into the sandbox workspace. 2. **Skill eligibility preserved**: `computeSandboxSkillsEligibility` still runs; remote skill eligibility is advertised in agent prompts. 3. **Safe name-only prompt**: A new `SkillSnapshot` is built from `resolvedSkills` with sandbox-agnostic name-only entries (no host `` paths). The `skills` array is preserved for env overrides. 4. **Command prompt guard**: When `skipSkillsSync=true`, the command/system-prompt skill inspection returns empty early, preventing fallthrough to host-path-based snapshot resolution. ## User Impact ```json5 { agents: { defaults: { sandbox: { skipSkillsSync: true, docker: { setupCommand: "mkdir -p /workspace/skills && cp -r /preloaded-skills/* /workspace/skills/" } } } } } ``` Safe-use contract: Skills must be preinstalled in the sandbox via `docker.setupCommand` or `docker.binds`. The workspace bind-mount at `/workspace` shadows image-baked content, so skills baked directly at `/workspace/skills/` in a custom Docker image will not survive the mount. Use a separate path (e.g., `/preloaded-skills/`) and copy via `setupCommand`. ## Evidence ### Real behavior proof (Docker container) > **Screenshot:** Docker sandbox verification output ``` ====================================================== Real Behavior Proof: skipSkillsSync Feature Container: openclaw-sandbox-test:latest Commit: 07821cbdb92 ====================================================== >>> 1. Config: skipSkillsSync=true { "agents": { "defaults": { "sandbox": { "mode": "all", "skipSkillsSync": true } } } } >>> 2. Sandbox explain: mode=all, sandboxed=true mode: all sandboxed: True >>> 3. Unit tests: 7 passed Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 7 passed (7) >>> 4. Code behavior: all OK SandboxConfig type : OK Config resolver : OK computeSkillsEligibility : OK Context branching : OK Name-only prompt (no paths) : OK Command prompt guard : OK Workspace info propagation : OK CLI runner propagation : OK ====================================================== ALL VERIFICATIONS PASSED ====================================================== ``` ### Test coverage (7 tests pass, 0 failures) - drops host snapshot and builds name-only prompt when `skipSkillsSync` is enabled - drops host snapshot (no remapping) when `skipSkillsSync` is absent (regression guard) - keeps snapshots for non-sandboxed runs (regression guard) - eligibility preserved in sandbox prompts (regression guard) - rebuilds sandbox prompts from materialized skill paths - preserves remote eligibility when rebuilding sandbox prompts - falls back to effective workspace for older sandbox contexts ### CI checks (all passing) - `check-prod-types` — pass - `check-test-types` — pass - `check-lint` — pass - `check-additional-extension-bundled` — pass - `check-additional-extension-package-boundary` — pass - `check-additional-extension-channels` — pass ### Changed files (9 files) | File | Change | |------|--------| | `src/config/types.agents-shared.ts` | Type definition for `skipSkillsSync` | | `src/config/zod-schema.agent-runtime.ts` | Zod schema with accurate safe-use contract | | `src/agents/sandbox/types.ts` | `SandboxConfig.skipSkillsSync` + `SandboxWorkspaceInfo.skipSkillsSync` | | `src/agents/sandbox/config.ts` | Config resolver propagation | | `src/agents/sandbox/context.ts` | Extracted `computeSandboxSkillsEligibility` helper + branching | | `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.ts` | Name-only prompt when `skipSkillsSync` | | `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/sandbox-skills.test.ts` | 2 new test cases | | `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts` | Pass `skipSkillsSync` to sandbox context | | `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-system-prompt.ts` | Early return guard against host snapshot fallthrough |
